items.information: ![West Coast Cubing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHNYIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--36307c5514bc8fbbcd5f7d0435fb449ed0337df6/tpc-banner-text.png) - This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) and [CubersLive](https://www.facebook.com/CubersLive) - CubersLive will be our main broadcast partner in live-streaming our event, as well as hosting our 3x3 finals head-to-head matchups! - The CubingUSA Western Championship 2023 will be held in Berkeley, California, on June 30 to July 2nd, 2023. Featuring 16 different events, Speedcubers from the CubingUSA-recognized West region of California, Hawaii, and Nevada will be eligibile for the title of Western Champion! - Tilden and Pauley Ballroom share the same address. Tilden is on the 5th floor and Pauley is on the 2nd floor. ***Our schedule is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.*** # Competitors can bring 1 guest for free. There will be a $10 guest/spectator fee for any additional guests that we will accept payment over PayPal pre-competition or at the registration desk. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcXcyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6ecde9f3cb802fb368ed5662c1da5253e07015a7/cubingUSA_4.png)

items.name: Utah Summer Side Events A 2023
items.information: * This is a twin competition with Utah Summer Side Events B. That means that you can only register for one or the other, but not both. * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * No outside food and drink is allowed in the venue. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with much of the information you need. * All first-time competitors should be present for the competitor tutorial at 10:00 AM.
